adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: Sam, Steve and Natasha rescue Wanda and Vision from Thanos's warriors in Edinburgh, and Sam fights beside her to defend Wakanda.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Avenger Sam helps rescue in Edinburgh.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Helps rescue Wanda and Vision in Edinburgh.
adds.evidence: Midnight and Glaive ambush Wanda and Vision in Edinburgh; Rogers, Romanoff and Wilson rescue them, take them to the Compound, then Wakanda, where they fight together.

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: Wong is with Strange in the Sanctum when Bruce Banner crashes in with word of Thanos, and they fight Ebony Maw and Cull Obsidian together in New York before Maw takes Strange and Wong stays to guard the Sanctum.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who fights beside Strange in New York.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend taken by Ebony Maw in New York.
adds.evidence: Opening Sanctum scene (Strange and Wong banter, Banner crashes in); they fight Maw and Obsidian; Maw abducts Strange while Wong returns to guard the Sanctum.

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: When Steve brings his team back to the Avengers Compound, Ross confronts him by hologram and orders Rhodey to arrest them, but Steve says he is done asking permission.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Orders Steve's arrest at the Avengers Compound.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A fugitive Avenger Ross orders arrested.
adds.evidence: At the Compound Ross mocks Rogers, Rogers says he is done asking permission, Ross orders Rhodes to arrest them and Rhodes cuts the call.

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: Thor arrives in the battle for Wakanda with a new axe, and he and Steve catch up mid-fight, Steve noting Thor's new haircut and Thor noting Steve's beard.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An old teammate who turns the tide in Wakanda.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An old teammate who greets Thor in Wakanda.
adds.evidence: Thor arrives with Stormbreaker, Rocket and Groot; 'The old friends caught up and Rogers noted Thor's haircut while the latter noted that Rogers had grown a beard like him.'

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: Steve leads the rescue of Wanda and Vision in Edinburgh and takes them to Wakanda to protect the Mind Stone.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An ally Steve rescues in Edinburgh and shelters in Wakanda.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Rescues Wanda and Vision in Edinburgh.
adds.evidence: Rogers, Romanoff and Wilson rescue Wanda and Vision in Edinburgh; Rogers proposes Wakanda to remove the Stone without killing Vision.

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: When Wanda arrives at the Avengers Compound with Steve's team, Ross orders them all arrested before Rhodey cuts him off.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An Avenger Ross orders arrested at the compound.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Orders Wanda's arrest at the compound.
adds.evidence: 'Rogers, Wilson, Romanoff, Vision, and Maximoff arrive, and Ross demands they all be arrested. Rhodes cuts his transmission off.'

owner_calls.title: Avengers: Infinity War
owner_calls.question: Tony and Steve never meet or speak here, but Tony carries the phone Steve sent him, says they are not on speaking terms, and nearly calls him before Bruce uses the phone to call Steve. Is that enough for an Infinity War stage?
options: Add: kind enemy, text 'Still estranged from Steve, Tony carries the phone Steve sent him and nearly calls him to warn him about Thanos.', on Steve's card about Tony 'Estranged teammate who nearly calls Steve about Thanos.', on Tony's card about Steve 'Estranged teammate whose phone Tony carries.'
None: a mention and an unmade call, no exchange
owner_calls.evidence: Banner urges Stark to call Rogers; Stark takes out the phone Rogers sent him and prepares to call before the Q-Ship arrives; Banner later uses it to call Rogers.
